statement.zh: Gibson 等《尼普尔发掘：第十二季》（OIC 23，1978）公布 Area WA 神庙序列与 Area WB 行政/居住建筑，并含旧巴比伦—加喜特陶器与泥板目录。
statement.en: Gibson et al., Excavations at Nippur: Twelfth Season (OIC 23, 1978), publish Area WA temple remains and Area WB administrative/residential buildings, including Old Babylonian–Kassite pottery treatments and a tablet catalogue.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only; density pass 3.
